verdict.rationale: Skyfire is an identity/payments platform, not an agent, so an official MCP server is applicable. Skyfire publishes one at https://mcp.skyfire.xyz/mcp, with a sandbox endpoint, API-key header auth, and named tools (find-sellers, create-kya-token, create-pay-token, create-kya-payment-token), plus setup docs for adding it to an agent. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP endpoint itself (the runtime probe only exercised the REST token API).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Your agent is now ready to discover sellers, generate `kya` or `pay` tokens, and instantly execute agentic commerce workflows!

documented tools are "find-sellers", "create-kya-token", "create-pay-token", and "create-kya-payment-token", authenticated with the skyfire-api-key header (sandbox at https://mcp-sandbox.skyfire.xyz/mcp)
The **Skyfire MCP server** enables agents to: Discover sellers, Create `kya`, `pay`, or `kya-pay` tokens, Orchestrate agent commerce workflows
